step.regelungen.title: Desired provisions
field.gueterstand.label: Matrimonial property regime
field.gueterstand.helpText: Community of accrued gains: each spouse keeps their own assets, but the gains are equalised on divorce/death. Separation of property: no mixing of assets, no equalisation. Community of property: everything becomes joint property (rare).
field.gueterstand_modifikation.label: Modification of the gains-equalisation
field.gueterstand_modifikation.placehold: e.g. exclude business assets from equalisation, cap amount
